{{Top|leg}}
[[File:CoronetSalon.jpg|250px|thumb|A salon in Coronet City, with the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] tapestry reading "Image Designer"]]
A '''salon''' was a place that [[Image Designer]]s would work in order to adjust a [[Species/Legends|beings]] appearance. Soothing [[Music/Legends|music]] would often be played inside.<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CoronetSalonInterior.jpg|250px|thumb|The interior of a salon]]
[[W:c:swg:Salon|Salons]] were a type of building in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
